skilled_jockey.name: Skilled Jockey
skilled_jockey.narrative_identity: The ship responds to the pilot's hands like an extension of their body. What looks reckless to passengers is precision to the pilot.

galaxy_mapper.name: Galaxy Mapper
galaxy_mapper.narrative_identity: Hyperspace lanes are not abstractions to this pilot. They are roads walked a hundred times, each one remembered by the way the ship shudders at the transition point.

stalker.name: Stalker
stalker.narrative_identity: Movement without sound. Presence without notice. The character has learned to occupy space without disturbing it.

street_smarts.name: Street Smarts
street_smarts.narrative_identity: The underworld has its own geography. This character reads it the way cartographers read terrain — instinctively, without having to think about why the alley narrows or the lights go out.

bypass_security.name: Bypass Security

effects.description: The character has trained knowledge of security systems. The GM should offer choices involving security bypass more readily.

bypass_security.narrative_identity: Locks are puzzles with known solutions. Security systems are designed by people who think like designers. This character thinks like a thief.

dead_to_rights.name: Dead to Rights
dead_to_rights.narrative_identity: Every shot is deliberate. The character does not spray and pray. They pick their moment, pick their target, and make it count.

grit.name: Grit
grit.narrative_identity: Endurance that does not announce itself. The character simply keeps going past the point where others stop.

toughened.name: Toughened
toughened.narrative_identity: The body learns to take damage. Not painlessly, but efficiently. Bruises that would have stopped the character a year ago are now absorbed without breaking stride.

rapid_recovery.name: Rapid Recovery
rapid_recovery.narrative_identity: Rest comes faster now. The character has learned to let go of tension the way a sailor sleeps through storms.

dodge.name: Dodge
dodge.narrative_identity: The character moves before they think. Instinct sharpened by years of being shot at.

quick_strike.name: Quick Strike
quick_strike.narrative_identity: The first move is the one that matters. This character reads the moment a situation turns violent and acts before the other side finishes deciding.

defensive_driving.name: Defensive Driving
defensive_driving.narrative_identity: Flying defensively is not about timidity. It is about knowing which vectors the enemy cannot reach and putting the ship there before they fire.

side_step.name: Side Step
side_step.narrative_identity: The character shifts weight before the shot arrives. Not a dramatic dive — a half-step, a lean, the kind of movement that comes from knowing exactly how far a blaster bolt spreads at twenty meters.

tricky_target.name: Tricky Target
tricky_target.narrative_identity: The ship does not fly in straight lines. It jinks, rolls, and slides through firing solutions like water through a grate.

convincing_demeanor.name: Convincing Demeanor
convincing_demeanor.narrative_identity: The character's lies function as social tools — not crude deception but performed sincerity, tactical empathy, the ability to become whoever the situation requires.

black_market_contacts.name: Black Market Contacts

effects.description: Has reliable black market contacts for acquiring illegal or restricted equipment. GM should offer acquisition choices when contextually appropriate.

black_market_contacts.narrative_identity: The character knows who to call. Not friends — professionals. The kind of people who have what you need and do not ask why you need it.

full_throttle.name: Full Throttle

effects.description: The character can push a vehicle to its maximum speed as a deliberate action. The GM should offer speed-related choices in vehicle scenes that other characters would not have.

full_throttle.narrative_identity: There is a point past which most pilots ease off the throttle. This character has never found it.

lets_ride.name: Let's Ride

effects.description: The character can mount or enter a vehicle as an incidental. In escape or chase scenes, the GM should allow immediate vehicle access without delay.

lets_ride.narrative_identity: The cockpit is home. Getting into it is not an action — it is a reflex. The character is already moving before the hatch finishes opening.

shortcut.name: Shortcut

effects.description: The character can find faster routes. In chase sequences, the GM can offer shortcut choices that other characters would not have access to.

shortcut.narrative_identity: Every station has its hidden geometry. Maintenance corridors, service lifts, the gaps between what the architects intended and what the residents discovered. This character knows them.

quick_draw.name: Quick Draw

effects.description: The character draws and holsters weapons as an incidental. In tense standoff scenes, the GM should reflect this readiness.

quick_draw.narrative_identity: The weapon appears. Not drawn — appeared. The motion is too practiced to have a visible beginning.

indistinguishable.name: Indistinguishable

effects.description: The character is forgettable by design. NPCs have difficulty recalling specific details about them. The GM should make identification and pursuit harder when this character is trying to disappear into a crowd.

indistinguishable.narrative_identity: Average height, average build, average face. The kind of person you look at and immediately forget. This is not an accident — it is a skill refined over years of wanting to be invisible.

natural_pilot.name: Natural Pilot

effects.narrative_prompt: A correction so small and so fast it might have been the ship itself deciding to live.

natural_pilot.narrative_identity: Some pilots fly. This one breathes it. When everything goes wrong, something deeper than training takes over.

natural_charmer.name: Natural Charmer

effects.narrative_prompt: A moment of recovery — the character finds the right angle just when everything seemed lost.

natural_charmer.narrative_identity: Words are this character's weapon. When a conversation turns hostile, they find the phrase that turns it back — not through intelligence but through an instinct for what people need to hear.

second_chances.name: Second Chances

effects.narrative_prompt: Not over. Not yet. The character reaches for something they did not know they had.

second_chances.narrative_identity: Failure is not the end. It is the moment before the recovery — the breath between falling and catching yourself.

dedication.name: Dedication
dedication.narrative_identity: A fundamental shift in who the character is. Not what they can do, but what they are made of.

parry.name: Parry
parry.narrative_identity: The blade catches what the body cannot. Each parry is a conversation — the opponent speaks, and the character answers.

reflect.name: Reflect
reflect.narrative_identity: The lightsaber becomes a shield. Blaster bolts arrive and are returned — not deflected randomly but guided, the Force whispering where each bolt will be.

niman_technique.name: Niman Technique
niman_technique.narrative_identity: The sixth form. The diplomat's form. The lightsaber responds not to muscle but to will — the Force itself guiding the blade where thought directs it.

shien_technique.name: Shien Technique
shien_technique.narrative_identity: The fifth form, reversed. Every defense becomes a counterattack, every block an opening. The blade moves with tactical cunning, not brute force.

soresu_technique.name: Soresu Technique
soresu_technique.narrative_identity: The third form. Pure defense. The blade traces the tightest possible arcs, conserving energy, outlasting the opponent. Victory through patience and geometric precision.

force_rating.name: Force Rating
force_rating.narrative_identity: The current deepens. What was a trickle becomes a river. The Force answers more readily, more fully, in ways the character cannot yet name.

uncanny_senses.name: Uncanny Senses
uncanny_senses.narrative_identity: The character notices what others miss. Not through vigilance but through something quieter — the Force pressing awareness into places the eyes cannot reach.

sleight_of_mind.name: Sleight of Mind
sleight_of_mind.narrative_identity: The character's presence dims in the Force. Not invisibility — something subtler. Attention slides past them the way water slides past a smooth stone.

sense_danger.name: Sense Danger
sense_danger.narrative_identity: A prickling at the base of the skull. Not thought — sensation. The Force speaking in the language of the body, warning before the mind has time to reason.

healing_trance.name: Healing Trance

effects.description: The character can enter a healing trance, using the Force to accelerate natural recovery. The GM should offer meditation choices during downtime that other characters would not have.

healing_trance.narrative_identity: The body heals itself. The Force simply removes the obstacles — pain, inflammation, the body's own panic response. What takes weeks takes hours.

force_protection.name: Force Protection
force_protection.narrative_identity: The Force cushions impact. Not visibly — no shimmering shield. The character simply absorbs damage that should have broken bone.

center_of_being.name: Center of Being
center_of_being.narrative_identity: Stillness at the center of violence. The character does not fight the chaos — they become the point around which it revolves.

saber_throw.name: Saber Throw

effects.description: The character can throw their lightsaber and recall it through the Force. The GM should offer ranged lightsaber attack choices when the character has their weapon drawn.

saber_throw.narrative_identity: The blade leaves the hand and keeps cutting. The Force holds the trajectory, curving it through targets and back to the palm. A weapon that never leaves.

calming_aura.name: Calming Aura
calming_aura.narrative_identity: The character radiates stillness. Not serenity — something harder than that. A calm that has been tested and did not break.

natural_blademaster.name: Natural Blademaster

effects.narrative_prompt: The blade finds the angle the body forgot. Muscle memory from a thousand repetitions of a form the character has never been taught.

natural_blademaster.narrative_identity: Some students of the blade learn through study. This one learns through the Force — the body moving before the mind finishes deciding.

natural_mystic.name: Natural Mystic

effects.narrative_prompt: The Force surges where concentration faltered. Not stronger — deeper. As if the current found a channel the character did not know existed.

natural_mystic.narrative_identity: The Force is not a tool to this character. It is a companion. When the connection wavers, it finds its own way back.

knowledge_is_power.name: Knowledge Is Power
knowledge_is_power.narrative_identity: The archives are not dead records. They are living memory, and this character reads them the way others read faces — for what they reveal and what they conceal.

researcher.name: Researcher
researcher.narrative_identity: Every question has been asked before. This character knows where to find the answers that were buried, forgotten, or deliberately hidden.

nobody_s_fool.name: Nobody's Fool
nobody_s_fool.narrative_identity: The character reads deception the way a mechanic reads engine noise — instinctively, catching the wrong note before the speaker finishes the sentence.

surgeon.name: Surgeon
surgeon.narrative_identity: Anatomy is not mystery — it is a schematic, and schematics can be repaired. The hands stay steady because the mind has already finished the procedure.

stim_application.name: Stim Application

effects.description: The character can administer stims and field medicine to others mid-scene as a deliberate, practiced action. The GM should offer stabilization and triage choices in danger scenes that characters without medical training would not get.

stim_application.narrative_identity: Everyone else sees chaos. The medic sees a queue — who bleeds out in two minutes, who can wait ten, who just needs to be told they will live.

gearhead.name: Gearhead
gearhead.narrative_identity: Machines confess to this character. A misaligned coupling, a fatigued weld, a power cell lying about its charge — all of it legible at a glance.

solid_repairs.name: Solid Repairs

effects.description: Repairs this character makes hold under stress: jury-rigs persist between scenes instead of failing at the dramatic moment, and the GM should treat their patched systems as reliable unless deliberately sabotaged.

solid_repairs.narrative_identity: Anyone can make a machine run. This character makes it run next week — work that outlives the emergency that demanded it.

inspiring_rhetoric.name: Inspiring Rhetoric
inspiring_rhetoric.narrative_identity: The right words at the right volume at the right moment. Not poetry — load-bearing speech, the sentence that makes a room decide to be brave.

field_commander.name: Field Commander

effects.narrative_prompt: The line holds because someone decides, out loud, that it holds.

field_commander.narrative_identity: Command is not rank. It is the habit of being the stillest point in a collapsing situation, so that everyone else's panic has somewhere to anchor.

intimidating_presence.name: Intimidating Presence
intimidating_presence.narrative_identity: Some rooms are won by warmth. This character's rooms are won by weather — the felt pressure of what they could do, offered politely, declined at cost.

tactical_mind.name: Tactical Mind

effects.description: The character reads engagements as systems — flanks, timing, lines of retreat, who breaks first. The GM should surface tactical-insight choices in conflict scenes that other characters would not be offered.

tactical_mind.narrative_identity: Where others see a firefight, this character sees a diagram with three exits and one mistake the enemy has not noticed yet.
